snippet.title: SinsKiller Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
SinsKiller is an isometric action arcade shooter set in a Dante-inspired Hell.
Play as a fallen battle-mage wielding arcane power to obliterate demonic hordes and face brutal bosses.
Face your sins. Kill them. Earn your redemption.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4280460/SinsKiller/

Trailer Editing and Original Audio by @riccardosiragusamusic 

#SinsKiller #IndieDev #Gaming #Steam #DarkFantasy
